title: Jonathan Greenard: My job is to help Nolan Smith, Jalyx Hunt continue to grow

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jonathan Greenard: My job is to help Nolan Smith, Jalyx Hunt continue to grow
sources.description: The Eagles traded for veteran edge rusher Jonathan Greenard in April and signed him to a new four-year contract because they think he can make an impact for them on the field.
